client.note: client.dll is export-only (its symbols are the VGUI library + the extern-C engine interface; the TS HUD classes are NOT exported and have NO RTTI). The HUD/prediction class MEMBER LAYOUTS are nonetheless recovered (`recovered_members` below) by binmap-matching our built client.so (full symbols) -> client.dll and reading each function's this+offset accesses — see scripts/coverage/client_members.py. Client commands/cvars are in `contract`; the server (ts_i386.so, unstripped) is the full `files` tree.
